description: CISA's advisories, newest first: alerts, joint cybersecurity advisories (#StopRansomware, state-sponsored activity), ICS and ICS-medical advisories, and analysis reports. Each with its kind, date, summary, the CVEs it names and the official page. Filter by kind, date, words, or the AI stack.

ai_stack.description: true: only advisories that name AI or agent software.

kind.description: One kind. Asking for one kind reads that kind's own feed, which reaches further back.

query.description: Words in the title, summary or CVEs, for example "ransomware" or "Siemens".

since.description: Only advisories published on or after this day (YYYY-MM-DD).

name: list_cyber_advisories
